summary: Backend for Session History + Focus Lock Streak is fully implemented and passes 9/9 pytest. Frontend Timer tab is MISSING the entire new UI — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx (378 lines, md5 9e4c64caa96e...) has zero occurrences of ScrollView, focus-streak-card, focus-history-card, focus-history-row, streakCard or historyCard. The `today` state variable and `loadToday()` fetch to /focus-sessions/today ARE wired up (so the endpoint is called), but nothing renders. DOM verification: after fresh reload and Metro restart, timer-screen has only 4 direct children (header, timer circle, focus-lock-banner, presetsRow) and no scrollable container. Body text ends at '2 hr' with no 'Today', no 'sessions in a row', no 'best'. This is a HIGH-priority feature gap — E1 must add the streak card + history card JSX (and the wrapping ScrollView) that the PRD calls for.

ui_bugs.component: Timer tab — Focus Lock streak card
ui_bugs.issue: focus-streak-card is not present in the DOM or in the source file. /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx has no JSX for the streak card (grep for 'focus-streak-card' / 'streakCard' returns 0). Backend field focus_lock_streak & focus_lock_best are being fetched into state but never rendered.

focus-history-card and focus-history-row are not present in the DOM or in the source file. Empty state and per-session rows (time / minutes / +XP) are unimplemented. /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx has 0 matches for those testIDs.

Timer body is not wrapped in a ScrollView (grep for '<ScrollView' in timer.tsx returns 0 hits, though it is imported on line 2). The screen is therefore not scrollable; content below the presets is not reachable even if added.

integration_issues.flow: Complete 1-min custom session → history + streak update
integration_issues.issue: Backend behaviour is correct: completing a 1-min session via UI writes to /api/focus-sessions (verified — /focus-sessions/today then returned 1 session and focus_lock_streak=1 for ui-test-user). But the UI never reflects this because the streak/history cards are not rendered. XP banner (+2 XP) does show and the timer resets, so the timer flow itself works.

Pre-existing warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — from Modal usage or a dependency. Non-blocking.

action_items: MAIN AGENT: Re-add the ScrollView wrapper and the two cards to /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx — they are missing from the current version on disk. Required elements: (a) wrap the timer body (from circleWrap down through startBtn) in <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.body} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false} keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'>; (b) after the running-stop button, add <View testID='focus-streak-card'> showing 🔥 {today?.focus_lock_streak ?? 0}, N sessions in a row, and best={today?.focus_lock_best ?? 0}; (c) then <View testID='focus-history-card'> with header 'Today's sessions', empty state when today?.sessions.length===0, and today.sessions.map(s => <View testID='focus-history-row' key={s.session_id}> time / duration_minutes / +xp_earned XP </View>).

MAIN AGENT: Add corresponding StyleSheet entries (streakCard, streakBig, streakTitle, streakSub, historyCard, historyHeader, historyTitle, historyTotal, historyEmpty, historyRow, historyTime, historyDur, historyXp, and a body paddingBottom for the ScrollView).
MAIN AGENT: The body of the timer content overflows on small screens once the new cards are added — ensure they sit inside the ScrollView, not below it, so the tab bar doesn't cover the last row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:600-626 POST /api/focus-sessions correctly $inc's focus_lock_streak atomically via find_one_and_update(ReturnDocument.AFTER) and then bumps focus_lock_best only if the new streak exceeds the previous best. Verified with pytest: seq 1→2→5 all persist correctly and best tracks the max.

server.py:628-652 GET /api/focus-sessions/today returns sessions newest-first (sort created_at -1), includes session_id/duration_minutes/xp_earned/created_at ISO string, plus total_minutes, total_xp, focus_lock_streak, focus_lock_best. Auth guard returns 401 for missing and bad tokens. Excludes _id from projection — safe.

server.py:333-352 POST /api/plants/focus-break correctly resets focus_lock_streak to 0 in BOTH branches: killed:true path (line 350) and killed:false / already-dead path (line 346). Verified with pytest — user's focus_lock_best is preserved (not reset).

timer.tsx:31-37 today state shape matches the API. timer.tsx:49-53 loadToday() runs on mount and after handleComplete (line ~111), stop (line ~157) and killTree — but the fetched values are never consumed by the JSX because the cards are missing on disk. Data pipeline is 100% ready; only the render layer is absent.
timer.tsx:2 imports ScrollView but the JSX never uses it (grep confirms 0 usages) — dead import.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx on disk is missing the JSX for both cards and the ScrollView wrapping — only the state hook (today) and the loadToday() fetch were added. This is a frontend implementation gap by E1, not a bundler/cache issue (verified after supervisor restart of expo, hard reload with cache bust, and md5 of the file on disk). grep counts: 'focus-streak-card' → 0, 'focus-history-card' → 0, '<ScrollView' → 0. Reproduction: open /(tabs)/timer, enumerate document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]') — returns 7 IDs only, none of which is streak/history. Fix: E1 to add the missing JSX + styles per the action_items above.
